title: Canonical finding row (per references/finding-schema.md)
description: Validates a single finding row in the JSON form that downstream tooling parses out of the markdown tables emitted by reviewer agents. The marker schema (FLOW_REVIEW_CYCLE pipe-delimited form) adds `status` and `disposition` fields stamped on by commands/review.md Phase 4 step 7; this row schema covers the agent-emitted shape (6 fields) and accepts the marker-only fields when present.

id.description: Stable reviewer-assigned identifier. The pattern is enforced by commands/review.md A.1 post-condition. Recommended prefixes: F (code-reviewer), SEC- (security-reviewer), ERR- (error-handler-inspector), INT- (integration-verifier). The `\Z` anchor (rather than `$`) rejects a trailing newline that Python `re` would otherwise accept in default mode — required because the pipe/comma marker grammar in merge.md treats `\n` as a separator.

category.description: Domain tag. The recommended controlled list (see references/finding-schema.md): security, correctness, edge-case, error-handling, performance, tests, runtime, visual, conventions, claim-verification. Free-form values are permitted but reduce searchability.

location.description: file:line, file:line-range, file (file-level), or URL (visual findings). The schema does not enforce a regex because the universe of valid locations spans paths, URLs, commit SHAs, branch names, and package@version.

suggested_fix.description: May be empty (use '—') when the fix is non-obvious; agent should append a paragraph below the table in that case.

status.description: Marker-only field added by commands/review.md Phase 4 step 7. Default is `open`.

disposition.description: Marker-only field added by commands/review.md Phase 4 step 7 (Path A) or omitted (Path B 5-field marker).
